'''Tairyō Shrine''' (たいりょうじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tarui, Gifu|Q1345531|qid=Q1345531}}, {{ill|Fuwa District, Gifu|Q521316|qid=Q521316}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and under the old {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=shrine rank}} it was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. It is regarded as the {{ill|Ichinomiya|Q1656379|qid=Q1656379|lt=Ninomiya}} of {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}}.

It is a {{ill|Sessha|Q135009904|qid=Q135009904}} of {{ill|Nangū Taisha|Q704967|qid=Q704967}}.

=== Enshrined deity ===
; {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Miyakatsuki Konomi}} (みやの すぐりの このみ)
: Miyakatsuki Konomi was the person who, during the {{ill|Jinshin War|Q2378252|qid=Q2378252}}, was ordered by Prince Ōama ({{ill|Emperor Tenmu|Q335181|qid=Q335181}}) to send troops to {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Fuwa Road}} (near {{ill|Fuwa no Seki|Q10868912|qid=Q10868912}}). It is said that by his achievements he became {{ill|Dairyō|Q11441890|qid=Q11441890}} of Fuwa District.

=== Location ===
* 765 Miyashiro Morishita, Tarui-chō, Fuwa-gun, Gifu Prefecture
*: About 0.5 km east of {{ill|Nangū Taisha|Q704967|qid=Q704967}}.

=== History ===
* Founding period unknown. One theory gives {{ill|715|Q23528|qid=Q23528}} (Reiki 1), after the death of Miyakatsuki Konomi.
* {{ill|1600|Q6720|qid=Q6720}} (Keichō 5): shrine buildings burned in the {{ill|Battle of Sekigahara|Q234188|qid=Q234188}}.
* {{ill|1636|Q6885|qid=Q6885}} (Kan'ei 13): rebuilt.
